description: This Swift source file defines the RemoteTunnelManager actor responsible for managing SSH tunnels to a remote gateway/control port, including creating, reusing, and restarting tunnels as needed.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor that manages SSH tunnels for remote gateway/control port forwarding, providing singleton access and methods to ensure the tunnels are active.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if an SSH tunnel is already active and listening on the desired port; reuses existing tunnel if possible, otherwise initiates a restart.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures an SSH tunnel is running, creating one if necessary, and returns the local forwarded port.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Terminates and clears any active SSH tunnel.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines whether a process descriptor corresponds to an SSH process based on command and executable path.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a restart process for the SSH tunnel with backoff handling.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the end of a restart process and resets related flags.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Implements backoff delay before attempting tunnel restart again.
